semiconductor_relevance: High — Harada specializes in equipment for contamination control and static elimination, which are critical in semiconductor manufacturing environments.
summary: Harada develops and manufactures advanced ionization and cleanliness monitoring equipment designed to meet stringent cleanliness standards in semiconductor clean rooms. Their products include ultra-clean bar-type ionizers and portable particle monitors, which enhance static elimination and surface cleanliness.
capabilities: ISO14644-1 Extended Class 1 compliant ultra-clean bar-type ionizer Model 5645
Portable surface cleanliness particle monitor for monitoring coarse particles
